_doc.purpose: Deterministic virtue-set recommendation rules. Consumed by scripts/suggest-virtues.mjs. NEVER auto-writes to hero files - produces evidence-backed suggestions for human review.
_doc.model: Two stages. (1) Detect a hero's stat DRIVERS from class + skill text. (2) Map each driver to the virtue SETS that grant the matching stat (set->stat is read straight from virtues.json, not invented). Suggest candidate sets, never a ranking.

driverShape.classes: optional - hero.class must be one of these (structural gate)
driverShape.patterns: optional - skill/relic text must match one of these regex (any). Both gates apply when both present.
driverShape.sets: candidate virtue set names whose stat benefits this driver

_doc.evidence: each suggested set carries the matched skill sentence (or a structural note like 'Support class') so the reviewer can verify.
_doc.noFlagRemove: Virtue choice has legit reasons beyond skills (Battle Power, availability, F2P access). The engine only ADDS candidate sets; it never suggests removing an existing virtueSet.
